_comment: Declarative herdr layout for a full-stack Flotion team — the herdr port of cmux/fs-team.layout.json. Template: scripts/herdr_spawn_fast.py substitutes __REPO__ (absolute repo path) and passes `root` to the layout.apply socket method, booting all five panes in one call instead of four sequential splits. Lead occupies the left half; plan/build-be/build-fe/test fill a 2x2 on the right. Unlike the cmux layout, panes carry NO command: herdr starts each agent afterwards with `agent start`, which yields a stable, addressable agent NAME plus readiness polling and real agent status. herdr's LayoutNode grammar has only two node types — {type:pane, label, cwd, env, command} and {type:split, direction:right|down, ratio, first, second}. NOTE: layout.apply REPLACES the target tab and returns a NEW tab_id; capture it from the response.
